reader.zh-Hant: SandboxWebSearchTool 會先做搜尋，再抓取目標頁面並做 HTML 無害化，最後包裝成 `<UNTRUSTED_WEB_DATA>` 文字輸出。
reader.en: SandboxWebSearchTool performs search + fetch, sanitizes HTML, and returns plaintext wrapped in `<UNTRUSTED_WEB_DATA>`.
reader.ja: SandboxWebSearchTool は検索とページ取得後に HTML をサニタイズし、`<UNTRUSTED_WEB_DATA>` で包んだテキストを返します。

symbols.name: SandboxWebSearchTool
symbols.summary: Controlled web search tool that sanitizes external content and marks it as untrusted.

tool_contract.name: web_search
tool_contract.description: Search the web in a sandbox-like readonly mode, sanitize fetched pages, and return plain Markdown text wrapped with <UNTRUSTED_WEB_DATA> tags.

methods.name: execute
methods.signature: execute(query: str, max_results: int = 3, save_policy: str = 'inline', output_target: str = 'memory', output_path: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs: Any) -> Union[str, Dict[str, Any]]
methods.summary: Searches web providers, fetches/sanitizes pages, and supports runtime file-routing payload.

runtime_notes.content: Optional env WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER_ORDER is a comma-separated list such as serper,google_cse,duckduckgo to override default attempt order.
All outputs are wrapped by <UNTRUSTED_WEB_DATA> to make trust boundary explicit.
script/style/noscript/iframe/svg/canvas and hidden/event-handler patterns are stripped before text conversion.
Supports save_policy/output_target/output_path to persist potentially large web search output as file-mode payload.
